description: Uses AI to analyze movie and TV-series metadata and automatically apply audience-target tags for kids, teens, or adults.
name: Auto Parental Tags
overview: Automatically classify Jellyfin content by its intended audience.

versions.changelog: Adds configurable movie and TV-series scanning, skips already-classified content, supports LocalAI model discovery and reasoning models, and updates compatibility to Jellyfin 10.11.11.
